title: The Burned Saint
text: The Court has burned a statue of a saint and left it in the square, blackened and cracked, its hands still raised in blessing. By day the crowds spit on it. By night pilgrims creep in to touch it, and the soot on their fingers never washes off.

options.label: Creep in and touch it with the pilgrims, under cover of the dark.

outcomes.text: It is still warm beneath the soot, a warmth that settles in you like comfort. Your fingers stay black for days.

options.label: The strongest carries it out of the Court, so that it may rest somewhere holy.

outcomes.text: The pilgrims cheer. The Court notices, sending its people after you.

options.label: Report the pilgrims to the Court. Their faith is no concern of yours.

outcomes.text: The Court rewards you in silver. The pilgrims weep as they are taken away; you hear them for a long time.
